subject: What's the meaning of "SCF energy" and "Total energy" in sqm output

messages.author: Suitian Lai
messages.body:
Hi,
I want to calculated the single point energy of a water molacular in DFTB3 level by sqm. The output of sqm contains "Total Energy" and "SCF Energy". Can someone explains the meaning of these two energy? Which is the single point energy of the water?
The input of sqm is
single point energy calculation
&qmmm
qm_theory = 'DFTB3',
qmcharge = 0,
maxcyc = 0,
verbosity = 4,
/
8 O 56.826 46.730 28.825
1 H 57.129 47.502 28.347
1 H 57.303 46.761 29.655
All the best,
Suitian Lai

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Thu, Oct 12, 2023, Suitian Lai via AMBER wrote:
>I want to calculated the single point energy of a water molacular in
>DFTB3 level by sqm. The output of sqm contains "Total Energy" and "SCF
>Energy". Can someone explains the meaning of these two energy? Which is the
>single point energy of the water?
"SCF energy" is the electronic structure energy computed by the QM model you
chose. "Total energy" is the sum of that plus any MM components in your
system. The total energy is the sum of the components (except for kinetic
energy) that are printed out: you should be able to do the sum by hand to
see how things add up.
...good luck...dac
